text: I had a 60-minute relaxing facial treatment and it was excellent. The person who took care of me was very gentle, and the massages were pleasant and relaxing. My skin feels revitalized. The staff doesn't speak much English, but they do their best and are very friendly, and the price is very reasonable for the service. I wanted to have a basic deep cleansing, but they advised against it because I already had some redness. After the treatment, my redness had disappeared, and my skin looked much better overall. I highly recommend it.

Bad experience. The doctor was not attentive and failed to remember my medical history. There were inconsistencies between what was discussed and my actual treatment records. The outcome was not as expected.
